'''Denan-Mal''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] male who was one of the members of the [[Three]], the Voss secular government, during the time of [[Czerka invasion of Voss]] in [[3624 BBY]]. That year, the [[Voss Mystics]] have received a vision that was given a very troubling meaning from the [[Interpreter (Voss)|Interpreters]], one that spoke of upcoming the danger which the Voss were powerless to do anything about. The Three agreed to receive and speak with the [[Alliance Commander]] to discuss vision and how it related to the plans of [[Darth Malgus]].<ref name="OW" />
